encounter.title: Act I Encounter 2 — Square Candidate A (6x6 seed 41)
encounter.notes: LD-003 square shortlist candidate A for Act I #2. 6x6 seed 41 (10 arrows: N3 E3 S2 W2). Pure Cross-Lock pattern. Urgent Grunt E (hp 2, ATTACK IN 3) has NO free arrows on start! Player cannot shoot East directly. Player must tap #1(N) first, which unlocks #0(E), which unlocks #3(E), which unlocks #4(N). Proven clean path without Rotate: 0 damage in 4 taps (#1 -> #0 -> #3 -> #4).
